Through these proposals, you get a set of basic guidelines and rules that will help you with the proper development of programs using Python. One example of such PEPs ever created is the PEP8. It is referred to as the “Python community Bible” and is a great guide to develop the best applications with a good look and feel. 3.Take care of your broken codes first While you are creating a Python application, you must give special attention to the broken codes and repair them immediately.
